title: Settings
name: What should we call you?
nameHint: Only stored on this phone. Leave it blank if you'd rather.
privacy: Everything you write stays on this phone. There are no accounts and no servers. Nothing is backed up — if you lose this phone, this is gone too.
eraseConfirm: This deletes every worry, entry, and session. It can't be undone.
silentSwitch: Calma stays quiet when your phone is on silent. Haptics still work.
languageHint: Calma follows your phone's language. Change it here if you'd rather.
notificationsHint: One reminder before your window. That's all.

help.title: Need more help?
help.body: Calma is a set of tools, not treatment. If things feel like too much, these lines are staffed by people who can help.

rows.name: What we call you
rows.hapticsHint: Something to follow with your eyes closed
rows.soundHint: A pebble, a bowl, a bell. Never speech
rows.windowNotifyHint: One quiet note, never a badge
rows.lockHint: However you unlock this phone, before opening your writing
rows.answersHint: Three answers, and all of them changeable

orbTheme.title: The shape you follow
orbTheme.orbHint: A warm light that grows and settles

plusSection.deviceChange: There are no accounts here, so a purchase belongs to your app store rather than to Calma. On a new phone, restoring is how it comes back.

answersScreen.title: What you told us
answersScreen.body: Three things you said when you set Calma up. Change any of them, or all of them, or none. Nothing here is scored and nothing has to be filled in.
answersScreen.windowOffer: Your worry window opens at {{current}}. Going by what you just changed, {{suggested}} might suit you better.

rhythmScreen.title: Your usual rhythm
rhythmScreen.body: The breath Calma offers when you open it. The others are always a tap away on the Breathe tab.
rhythmScreen.whenItApplies: A change here takes effect the next time you start, never partway through a breath.

windowScreen.body: When your worries get their twenty minutes. Set it for a time you are usually free, and a while before you want to sleep.

privacyScreen.title: Your writing
privacyScreen.body: Everything you've written lives on this phone, in an encrypted file only you can open. We can't read it, and it never leaves unless you send it somewhere yourself.
privacyScreen.footer: No analytics on what you write. No advertising, ever.

crisis.title: When it's more than this
crisis.body: Calma is a breathing app. It isn't care, and some nights need a person.
crisis.gpDetail: Worth saying out loud to someone who can follow up
crisis.footer: Reachable from Settings at any time, and offered — never pushed — if things look heavy for a while.

deleteSheet.nothing: There's nothing here to delete yet.
deleteSheet.body: They'll be gone from this phone for good — we don't keep a copy anywhere to restore from.
